name: stage15_summary_report

stages.title: ROS2/C++ control algorithm engineering tests
stages.claim: C++ gait scheduler, swing trajectory and torque safety filter are built and tested through ROS2/CMake/GTest.
stages.boundary: No torque publishing or hardware execution.

stages.title: C++ contact force QP demo
stages.claim: A C++ contact-force constraint demo validates stance/swing force allocation, normal force and friction constraints.
stages.boundary: No OSQP C++ dependency and no closed-loop robot torque execution.

stages.title: contact force to nominal torque candidate rollout
stages.claim: Contact force candidates are mapped to 12D torque-candidate statistics through a nominal mapping and alpha sweep.
stages.boundary: No real Pinocchio Jacobian, no MuJoCo torque and no ROS torque publisher.

stages.title: Pinocchio Jacobian candidate rollout
stages.claim: Pinocchio foot Jacobian based J^T f candidate rollout is available in an offline dry-run path.
stages.boundary: Synthetic/audit kinematic model may be used; no MuJoCo torque execution.

stages.title: model readiness audit
stages.claim: MJCF/URDF/Xacro resources are audited for controlled joints, foot frames and mapping readiness.
stages.boundary: Audit only; no Jacobian execution or torque execution.

stages.title: real-model Jacobian candidate rollout
stages.claim: Stage 15.5 model metadata or loadable URDF is connected to Pinocchio J^T f candidate generation.
stages.boundary: If MJCF fallback is used, real geometry is not claimed; no MuJoCo torque execution.

stages.title: MuJoCo candidate compatibility audit
stages.claim: MuJoCo model, joint names, actuators and candidate order are checked through kinematic mj_forward.
stages.boundary: No mj_step and no nonzero data.ctrl.

stages.title: bounded MuJoCo torque smoke test
stages.claim: A low-amplitude actuator command path is tested with mj_step under strict clipping.
stages.boundary: Smoke test only; not stable locomotion and not MPC-WBC closed-loop validation.

stages.title: MuJoCo J^T f candidate injection
stages.claim: The Stage 15.6 J^T f candidate is injected into MuJoCo with low alpha for short-horizon safety testing.
stages.boundary: Short-horizon only; no stable locomotion claim and no hardware claim.

stages.title: MuJoCo torque-smoke policy comparison
stages.claim: Zero ctrl, deterministic smoke waveform and J^T f candidate are compared under identical short-horizon safety metrics.
stages.boundary: Safety/compatibility comparison only; not a walking-performance benchmark.

claimable_items: ROS2/C++ control algorithm modules are buildable and testable through colcon/GTest.
A C++ contact-force QP demo validates contact-mode and friction/normal-force constraints.
Contact-force to torque-candidate dry-runs exist with alpha sweep evidence.
Pinocchio Jacobian based J^T f candidate generation has an offline validation path.
Model readiness and MuJoCo joint/actuator compatibility are audited with archived reports.
Bounded MuJoCo actuator-command smoke tests and policy comparisons have been run in short horizon.
non_claimable_items: Stable locomotion from the new J^T f candidate path.
ROS torque publisher readiness for hardware.
